prompt.description: The prompt to send to the model.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a text prompt to a Clarifai-hosted LLM (e.g. GPT-4) and returns the generated text completion. Use to generate or transform text via Clarifai rather than calling the provider directly; supply the Clarifai model id (looked up by name) and the prompt. Generative and non-deterministic, so repeated calls may return different text.

auth.description:

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the model.

aiMetadata.description: Generates an image from a text prompt using a Clarifai text-to-image model (e.g. DALL-E mini) and returns it as a written file. Use when an agent needs to create a picture from a description; supply the Clarifai model id (looked up by name) and the prompt. Generative, so each call produces a new image.

visual_classifier_model.name: visual_classifier_model
visual_classifier_model.description: Call an visual classifier AI model to recognize concepts

modelUrl.description: URL of the Clarifai model. For example https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition OR a specific version such as https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition/versions/aa7f35c01e0642fda5cf400f543e7c40. Find more models at https://clarifai.com/explore/models

file.description: URL or base64 bytes of the image or video to classify

aiMetadata.description: Runs an image or video through a Clarifai visual classification model and returns the recognized concepts with confidence scores. Use to tag, categorize, or detect content in visual media; supply the model URL and the file as a URL or base64 bytes. Read-only inference, safe to repeat.

text_classifier_model.name: text_classifier_model
text_classifier_model.description: Call a text classifier AI model to recognize concepts

modelUrl.description: URL of the Clarifai model. For example https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition OR a specific version such as https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition/versions/aa7f35c01e0642fda5cf400f543e7c40. Find more models at https://clarifai.com/explore/models

aiMetadata.description: Runs input text through a Clarifai text classification model and returns the recognized concepts with confidence scores (e.g. sentiment or topic labels). Use to categorize or score text; supply the model URL and the text. Read-only inference, safe to repeat.

image_text_model.name: image_text_model
image_text_model.description: Call an image to text AI model

modelUrl.description: URL of the Clarifai model. For example https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition OR a specific version such as https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition/versions/aa7f35c01e0642fda5cf400f543e7c40. Find more models at https://clarifai.com/explore/models

file.description: URL or base64 bytes of the image to classify

aiMetadata.description: Runs an image through a Clarifai image-to-text model and returns the generated text (e.g. a caption or description). Use to describe or extract text from an image; supply the model URL and the file as a URL or base64 bytes. Read-only inference, safe to repeat.

text_text_model.name: text_text_model
text_text_model.description: Call a text to text AI model

modelUrl.description: URL of the Clarifai model. For example https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition OR a specific version such as https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition/versions/aa7f35c01e0642fda5cf400f543e7c40. Find more models at https://clarifai.com/explore/models

aiMetadata.description: Runs input text through a Clarifai text-to-text model and returns the generated text (e.g. translation, summarization, or rewriting). Use to transform text via a specific Clarifai model; supply the model URL and the input text. Generative, so repeated calls may return different output.

audio_text_model.name: audio_text_model
audio_text_model.description: Call a audio to text AI model

modelUrl.description: URL of the Clarifai model. For example https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition OR a specific version such as https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/models/general-image-recognition/versions/aa7f35c01e0642fda5cf400f543e7c40. Find more models at https://clarifai.com/explore/models

file.description: URL or base64 bytes of the audio to classify

aiMetadata.description: Runs an audio file through a Clarifai audio-to-text model and returns the transcribed text. Use to transcribe speech or audio; supply the model URL and the file as a URL or base64 bytes. Read-only inference, safe to repeat.

post_inputs.name: post_inputs
post_inputs.description: Add inputs to your clarifai app

userId.description: User ID to associate with the input

appId.description: App ID (project) to associate with the input

file.description: URL or base64 bytes of the audio to classify

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file (image, video, audio, or text) as a new input into a specific Clarifai app, where it is stored for indexing, search, or training. Use to add data to a Clarifai dataset; requires the target user ID, app ID, and the file as a URL or base64 bytes. Each call appends a new input, so it is not idempotent.

workflowUrl.description: URL of the Clarifai workflow. For example https://clarifai.com/clarifai/main/workflows/Demographics. Find more workflows at https://clarifai.com/explore/workflows

file.description: URL or base64 bytes of the incoming image/video/text/audio to run through the workflow. Note: must be appropriate first step of the workflow to handle that data type.

aiMetadata.description: Runs a single input (image, video, text, or audio) through a multi-model Clarifai workflow and returns the per-model results. Use to apply a chained pipeline of Clarifai models in one call; supply the workflow URL and a file as a URL or base64 bytes, matching the data type the workflow expects. Read-only prediction that stores nothing, so repeating the call yields the same results.

pt.\nFollow these instructions to get your:
Siga estas instruções para obter sua Chave PAT do Clarifai (Token de Acesso Pessoal:
1. Vá para a [aba de segurança](https://clarifai.com/settings/security) na sua conta Clarifai e gere um novo token PAT.
2. Copie o token PAT e cole-o no campo Chave do PAT.
